name: HNS_ACTIONS
description: HNS ACTIONS. This table stores all Action related data.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for Action table.

columns.name: ACTION_NO
columns.description: Unique user-defined identifierfor Action table.

columns.name: RECOMMEND_ID
columns.description: Recommendation Identifier. Foreign key for HNS_INVEST_RECOMMENDS table.

columns.name: INCIDENT_ID
columns.description: Incident Identifier. Foreign key for HNS_INCIDENTS_SUMMARY.

columns.name: COMPLETED_FLAG
columns.description: Completed flag. Signifies whether the Action is completed.

columns.name: ACTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: ACTION_STATUS_CODE column: Current Action Status. Lookup to FND_LOOKUP STATUS.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Deleted flag. Signifies whether the Action is deleted..

columns.name: ACTION_SUMMARY
columns.description: Summary information for an Action.This is a user entered field.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Detailed description for an Action.This is a user entered field.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of Action identifier.E.g. Corrective, preventive

columns.name: PRIORITY_CODE
columns.description: Priority Identifier. Seed data from FND_LOOKUP with Lookup Type = HNS_PRIORITY

columns.name: REQ_RESOURCES
columns.description: Required Resources for an action. The column is comma delimited with the req resources will be separated by comma.

columns.name: ACTION_DATE
columns.description: The date when the action was created and assigned to the action owner.

columns.name: ACTION_REVIEWER_EMAIL_FLAG
columns.description: The flag  to send email notification to action reviewer.

columns.name: ACTION_APPROVER_EMAIL_FLAG
columns.description: The flag  to send email notification to action approver.

columns.name: ACTION_PRECOM_EMAIL_FLAG
columns.description: The flag  to send email notification to action precomm approver.

columns.name: LESSONS_LEARNED
columns.description: Lessons Learned.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_COST
columns.description: Estimated cost associated with the Action.

columns.name: EST_COST_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Estimated Cost Currency Code. Currency code related to the estimated cost. Default to USD.
